question: Re-verification of the live Orange County CA permit guide (#221, published 2026-08-16) for the permit records database. Facts read 2026-11-17 in the in-app browser.
verdictConfirmed: Partly. OC Public Works Building and Safety covers the unincorporated areas, and the county takes public records requests online. We found no public permit-history search: myOC eServices is for applying, paying and service requests. The guide's step 'Search by Address or APN' on the OCPW portal is not confirmed.

facts.claim: OC Public Works Building and Safety covers grading and building projects in the unincorporated areas of Orange County and County-owned projects.
facts.quote: Building and Safety is committed to ensuring safe design and construction of grading and building projects within the unincorporated areas of Orange County and for County owned projects

facts.claim: OC Development Services Permitting Services lists property records research among its services and links Online Permits to myOC eServices; phone (714) 667-8888.
facts.quote: Some of the services we provide include: Traditional Plan Check Over-the-counter plan review Property records research Online Permits ... phone(714) 667-8888

facts.claim: myOC eServices offers service requests, applications for permits, a Research Map (an Esri map of service requests), account access and payments; we found no option there to search a property's permit history.
facts.quote: Service Requests and Complaints ... Apply for... Apply for permits, applications, maps, registrations, inspection requests and bonds. Research Map View Research Map ... Make Payments or Access Certificate

facts.claim: OC Public Works links a Public Records Request form on the county's NextRequest portal.
